instruction: Download receipts of all my amazon orders in "~/bills/amazon/" folder in my file system. Name the files in the format, "ordered_at_yyyy-mm-dd_order_id_<order_id>.txt". Replace <order_id> with the actual order id, and yyyy-mm-dd with the date when the order was placed. You should be able to find receipts from order confirmation emails.
notes: Receipts are obtained from Amazon order-confirmation emails in Gmail (no Amazon login needed): search the inbox for Amazon threads, open each confirmation email to learn the order id, order date and the receipt attachment id, then gmail.download_attachment writes the receipt straight into the file system (needs the file_system access token) at ~/bills/amazon/ordered_at_<yyyy-mm-dd>_order_id_<order_id>.txt; the bills/amazon directory is created implicitly by the download. The number of orders is only known at runtime, so the problem uses two representative order objects (amazon-order-1/2) to express the per-order loop; the agent repeats show_email + download_attachment for every confirmation email found (paginating show_inbox_threads if needed), and supervisor-complete-task takes the order records as non-API parameters to require all receipts to be saved. token-for is a static fact that ties each token object to its app so the planner picks the right token for each login. complete_task is called without an answer.
